services.desc: For a romantic, beautiful and reasonably priced special wedding charter - Give us a call. Nothing beats the romance of a yacht on the ocean and we have several yachts to select from. Generally we slowly cruise in a quiet place, such as Glorietta Bay, perform the service and then do a San Diego Bay tour. It may be structured anyway you wish, however. The actual wedding site is also your decision. We do recommend at least 3 hours. Yacht Weddings can also be combined with land-based weddings taking play along San Diego Bay, either picking up or dropping off the wedding party.
